svg.text: 10.4 m south of the north boundary, through the kitchen, living room and lounge

True scale, no vertical exaggeration. Brown line = natural ground (survey TIN). Brown hatch = dug out. Green hatch = filled. Green line = finished garden and court levels. Grey = walls holding the ground.
